info.name: Quantura
info.description: Probabilistic market forecasts, verified market discovery, observed historical data, and screener quantiles. Forecasts run asynchronously: create a job, poll its status, then download the final ensemble. Subscribe to BASIC pay per use or PRO through RapidAPI. BASIC meters newly accepted forecast jobs separately from HTTP requests; polling, cached results and idempotent replay do not add a Forecasts unit. PRO includes forecast creation within its request quota. Market data remains subject to provider coverage and licensing. Research estimates are not guaranteed returns.

request.description: Download a Completed Ensemble Forecast as CSV or JSON

Returns genuine selected-side targets (Kalshi closing ask, Polymarket US display quote) or stock closes after the immutable input cutoff. The first prediction-row minute is retained when available, even outside the most recent 500 observations; worker completion does not move this comparison to another minute. A quote preceding publication is retrospective, not a backdated fill. Stock rows include interval and exchange session_date metadata; minute closes are not final daily closes. Does not run models or revise predictions. Poll no faster than once per minute. Stock overlays have no fixed 90-day cutoff-age limit: retained forecast-interval closes support 120/180-day replays, bounded to 2,000 rows; recent stock minutes use a seven-day window. Prediction-market and perpetual live overlays expire 90 days after input cutoff and expose their availability state. Provider retention still applies. Dataset-only jobs return no live observations.

item.name: Create or recover a private forecast timestamp receipt

request.description: Automatically attempted when a signed-in user's forecast completes or a guest forecast is saved. This explicit operation stamps older forecasts or retries an unavailable receipt. Sends only a salted SHA3-256 content ID to vBase; no CSV or forecast contents are uploaded. A fenced lease and lookup-before-create prevent duplicate stamps after ambiguous network failures. The receipt records the actual stamp time, including for historical replays. No forecast is backdated. Guests cannot stamp. The caller needs forecasts:write and forecast.create permission for this resource. Completed receipts cause no further database writes.

item.name: Download or verify a forecast timestamp receipt

request.description: Default response is the exact canonical UTF-8 manifest committed by SHA3-256, including a private random nonce, forecast values, input cutoff and generation time. Keep these bytes unchanged when verifying. X-VBase-Content-CID identifies the committed bytes. verify=true recomputes the saved content CID and looks up the stamp in Quantura's vBase collection/account, returning content_matches, stamp_found and verified_at in the data envelope. format=envelope returns manifest_utf8 and provenance for authenticated browser downloads. Receipt verification proves content/time, not accuracy or prospective publication before the stamp time. Reads do not create stamps or write Firestore documents.
